title: Coverage Metrics
description: Understand line, branch, and path coverage.

data.text: **Code coverage** measures how much of your code is exercised by tests. Common metrics include line coverage, branch coverage, and path coverage.

terms.definition: Percentage of code lines executed during tests.
Percentage of decision branches (if/else, switch) executed.
Percentage of possible execution paths through the code.

data.title: Goal, Not Gospel
data.text: 100% coverage does not guarantee bug-free code. Focus on meaningful coverage of critical paths, not just hitting every line.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Line coverage is the most common metric
Branch coverage catches untested conditional logic
High coverage does not equal high quality
data.takeaway: Use coverage as a guide, not a target.
